notes: Optimization: game patterns compile once and are cached
patch_notes: Optimization pass, no features changed. The game matcher no longer re-translates every glob pattern on every 2-second tick: patterns are compiled once and cached, and the process-name set is built once per tick. Matching results are byte-for-byte the same as before - new test round 23 proves equivalence with the plain fnmatch matcher across the tricky cases (FiveM globs, case, disabled games, near-miss names) and checks the speed on 5,000 process names. All 23 rounds pass.
